Maria / team —

Per Ben’s note, attaching an econ workbook and redlineable SOW excerpt that ties discounts to three milestones:
1) Signed PO (Commencement) — 20% limited-time discount applied to the first 3 months of usage;
2) Pilot Integration (end of pilot, acceptance tests passed) — additional 10% applied going forward;
3) Sustained Commit (3 consecutive months at committed volume) — additional 5% to reach maximum 35% total.

Cancellation/missed ramp clause (proposal): if sustained commit is not met within 6 months, customer may elect to (a) reduce to a lower commit tier with a 12% pricing adjustment retroactively applied, or (b) terminate with 60 days notice and receive prorated credit of any prepaid platform fee. We capture remediation steps in the MAP so the success criteria are objective.

Monthly platform fee amortization is fine — we show the monthly amortized option and the one-time invoice option in the workbook.

Next steps: if procurement signs off on the PO language, we’ll produce a DocuSign bundle (SOW + MAP + Order Form). Targeting doc send by Feb 2 given your Feb 8 kickoff.
